sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This second application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.720/2021 registered at Police Station Sarai, District Singrauli for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 307, 302, 304B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 17.01.2021.

The applicant's earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 21.03.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.10410 of 2022 with liberty to revive the same after recording of the statement of material witness.

sentences.text: The counsel for the applicant submits that he has filed the order-sheet showing that the witnesses are not turning-up to the Court.
He submits that Udasia Sakes is the material witness who has given the information to the father of the deceased about the incident occurred and the role of the applicant.
However, at this stage I am not inclined to consider this bail application, accordingly, it is rejected.
The trial Court is directed to make all endeavours to get the statement of the witnesses recorded especially Udasia Saket.

If the witnesses are not turning- up to the Court for getting their statement recorded, then the Court may adopt coercive mode for securing the presence of the witnesses for recording their statement.
If the statement of Udasia Saket is not recorded within a further period of two months, then the applicant will have liberty to revive his prayer for bail.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE ac/-
